title: Physisorption and chemisorption
caption: A molecule approaching a surface first feels weak van der Waals attraction: a shallow well far out (physisorption, about 20 kJ mol⁻¹). Closer in, it can form chemical bonds to the surface: a much deeper well (chemisorption, often over 200 kJ mol⁻¹). Illustrative curves.
alt: Energy against distance from the surface: a shallow minimum at 0.16 nm for physisorption and a deep minimum at 0.095 nm for chemisorption.
description: Physisorption: shallow minimum far from the surface.
Chemisorption: a deep minimum close to the surface.

checks.name: chemisorption: a well over six times deeper, closer to the surface
